title: Preparations of Phenol: Cumene, Dow, & Diazonium Routes
topics: 6. Industrial & Laboratory Preparations of Phenol Overview
6.1 The Industrial Cumene Hydroperoxide Process (>90% Global Phenol Production)
Benzene + Propene ──[H₃PO₄ / 523 K]──► Cumene (Isopropylbenzene) ──[O₂ / 368 K]──► Cumene Hydroperoxide
Acid Cleavage (10% H₂SO₄) yielding Phenol + Acetone (Valuable Co-product)
Dow Process (Ph-Cl + NaOH at 623 K, 300 atm ──► Phenol)
Diazonium Salt Hydrolysis (Ph-NH₂ ──► Ph-N₂⁺Cl⁻ ──[Warm H₂O]──► Phenol + N₂)
quickSummary: Over 90% of global phenol is produced by the Cumene process: Benzene + Propene ──► Cumene ──► Cumene Hydroperoxide ──► Phenol + Acetone co-product. Other routes include Dow process (chlorobenzene + NaOH, 623 K/300 atm) and diazonium hydrolysis (Ph-N₂⁺Cl⁻ + warm water).
summary: Master the commercial cumene hydroperoxide process and laboratory synthesis routes for phenol.

conceptBreakdown.title: 6. The Industrial Cumene Hydroperoxide Process

summaryBox.title: Cumene Process Reaction Cascade
summaryBox.takeaway: Cumene ──(O₂)──► Cumene Hydroperoxide ──(H⁺)──► Phenol + Acetone (valuable solvent byproduct).

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
CUMENE HYDROPEROXIDE PROCESS
                      
   Benzene + Propene ──[$\text{H}_3\text{PO}_4 / 523\text{ K}$]──► **Cumene (Isopropylbenzene)**
                                                              │
   Air Oxidation ($\text{O}_2 / 368\text{ K}$) ───────────────┘
                               │
   **Cumene Hydroperoxide** ($\text{Ph-C(CH}_3)_2\text{-O-O-H}$)
                               │
   Cleavage via $10\%\text{ H}_2\text{SO}_4$ (323–333 K)
                               │
   $$\mathbf{\text{Phenol } (\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{OH}) + \text{Acetone } (\text{CH}_3\text{COCH}_3)}$$
conceptBreakdown.content: The Cumene process is the dominant industrial route because it converts inexpensive benzene and propene into Phenol while producing Acetone as a valuable co-product.

conceptBreakdown.title: 6.1 Other Synthetic Preparations of Phenol
conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
OTHER PHENOL SYNTHESES:

• Dow Process:         Ph-Cl + NaOH ──[623 K, 300 atm]──► Ph-ONa ──[H⁺]──► Phenol
• Diazonium Route:     Ph-NH₂ ──[NaNO₂/HCl, 273–278 K]──► Ph-N₂⁺Cl⁻ ──[Warm H₂O]──► Phenol + N₂ ↑
• Benzenesulfonate:   Ph-SO₃H + NaOH ──[Fuse 573 K]──► Ph-ONa ──[H⁺]──► Phenol
conceptBreakdown.content: Review the classic chemical synthesis routes including aryl halide hydrolysis and diazonium replacement.
